standards.title: Drinking Water — Specification
standards.description: Prescribes essential physical, chemical, bacteriological, toxic, and radioactive requirements for drinking water supplied across Indian municipalities, commercial establishments, and rural supply networks.

standards.title: Metallic Materials — Bend Test
standards.description: Specifies the method for determining the ability of metallic materials to undergo plastic deformation in bending, establishing test piece dimensions, bending angle, mandrel diameter, and surface crack acceptance criteria.

standards.title: Carbon Steel Billets, Blooms, Slabs and Bars for Forgings — Specification
standards.description: Covers chemical composition (Classes 1 through 6), mechanical properties, manufacturing process (fully killed steel), grain size, and ultrasonic testing requirements for carbon steel products intended for hot forgings.

standards.title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice
standards.description: The foundational standard for general structural engineering in India, outlining criteria for design, materials (cement, aggregates, water, admixtures), concrete grades (M10 to M80), durability, reinforcement detailing, and structural fire protection.

standards.title: Covered Electrodes for Manual Metal Arc Welding of Carbon and Carbon Manganese Steel — Specification
standards.description: Specifies requirements for covered carbon steel manual metal arc welding (MMAW) electrodes, including classification coding (e.g. EB5426H3X), coating types (rutile, basic, cellulosic), mechanical properties, hydrogen content, and radiographic quality.

standards.title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement — Specification
standards.description: Specifies requirements for high strength thermo-mechanically treated (TMT) and cold twisted deformed steel bars and wires (Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 550D, Fe 600) for structural reinforced concrete.

standards.title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V — Specification
standards.description: Specifies requirements for single and multi-core polyvinyl chloride (PVC) insulated and PVC sheathed cables with copper and aluminium conductors for residential, commercial, and industrial power wiring.

standards.title: Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations
standards.description: Comprehensive design, selection, erection, testing, and commissioning guidelines for internal electrical wiring installations in domestic, commercial, and industrial premises.

standards.title: 53 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement — Specification
standards.description: Specifies chemical requirements (ratio of percentage of lime to percentages of silica, alumina and iron oxide) and physical requirements (fineness, setting time, compressive strength at 3, 7, and 28 days) for 53 Grade OPC.

standards.title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel — Specification
standards.description: Covers requirements for steel plates, sections, strips, and flats (grades E 250 through E 650) used in welded, bolted, and riveted structural fabrication for bridges, buildings, ships, and heavy machinery.

standards.title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets of Rated Voltage up to and Including 250 Volts and Rated Current up to and Including 16 Amperes — Specification
standards.description: Specifies dimensional, insulation resistance, temperature rise, mechanical strength, and shutter safety requirements for 2-pin and 3-pin household plugs and socket-outlets (6A and 16A ratings).

standards.title: Safety of Toys — Part 1: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
standards.description: Mandatory safety criteria for children's toys against choking hazards (small parts test), sharp edges, points, projectile kinetic energy limits, entrapment, acoustic limits, and folding mechanisms.

standards.title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes — Safety Requirements for Portable Sealed Secondary Lithium Cells and Batteries: Part 2 Lithium Systems
standards.description: Specifies safety and test procedures (continuous charging, external short-circuit, thermal abuse, crushing, over-charging, forced discharge) for portable secondary lithium-ion cells and battery packs under the Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS).

standards.title: AC Static Transformer Operated Watthour and VAR-Hour Meters, Class 0.2 S and 0.5 S — Specification
standards.description: Applies to newly manufactured transformer-operated static watt-hour and VAR-hour meters of accuracy classes 0.2 S and 0.5 S for active and reactive electrical energy measurement in sub-stations and high-tension grid points.

standards.title: General Requirements for Competence of Assay and Hallmarking Centres
standards.description: Specifies technical and management requirements for the operation and competence of assaying and hallmarking centres assessing purity of gold and silver jewellery and artefacts in India.

standards.title: Hardened Concrete — Methods of Test - Part 1: Testing of Strength of Hardened Concrete, Section 1: Compressive, Flexural and Split Tensile Strength
standards.description: Establishes standardized apparatus, specimen preparation (cubes, cylinders, prisms), curing, loading rates, and calculation methods for compressive, flexural, and split tensile strength of hardened concrete.

standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Part 1: General Requirements
standards.description: Deals with the safety of electrical appliances for household and similar purposes (rated voltage not exceeding 250 V for single phase), including protection against electric shock, heating, leakage current, moisture resistance, and mechanical hazards.

standards.title: Methods of Test for Petroleum and Its Products - Part 34: Determination of Flash Point by Pensky-Martens Closed Cup Tester
standards.description: Prescribes the closed cup test method using the Pensky-Martens apparatus for determining the flash point of fuel oils, lubricating oils, liquids containing suspended solids, and liquids tending to form surface films under test conditions.
